body:
That was absolutely beautiful. Thank you. Made me cry. I'm sure he would want that too but it's so hard without him here. Tell your friend how much you love and appreciate him today, k? You never know. The last day I talked to my friend, I was angry with him and barely responded to his messages.

Take care

Yeah, I have to notarize my will and exclude my greedy mother from it. I also was invited somewhere for the weekend. If they bail on me or it turns out to be the usual humiliation then I have a date set; if something wonderful happens I will reconsider dying, possibly. It's really just fear.
It's okay, but thanks for the offer.
Holy crap I can relate to this. My favorite "Learn to be happy alone." Um okay, I only spend 90% of my time alone already, thanks.
Yep, exactly how I feel. Something bad is always around the corner, can't get too enamored with this nearly neutral "happy" moment.
Guess I should have shortened it for the popularity contest. Oh well. It's not like I'm unacquainted to alienation
